description: $0.01 USDC on Solana per check - the payment buys one signed SDK version-safety report for the one SDK name + version you submit: per-flaw outcomes for all 25 recorded flaws in the pinned snapshot x402-sdk-flaws/v1-2026-10-24 (AFFECTED / FIXED / NOT-APPLICABLE / NOT-ESTABLISHED), the overall verdict (including NOT-IN-RECORD when the submitted SDK or version is outside the pinned record's established data), and the factors. Factors printed; no composite score. Nothing submitted is stored beyond the payments ledger's closed field list.

sdk.description: The x402 SDK name to check against the pinned flaw snapshot.

version.description: The SDK version to check (semver: optional leading v, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, optional -prerelease / +build).

name: sdk_safety_check
